# Verbora

> A word puzzle for learning languages: find words with a letter wheel; every word comes with its own picture, meaning and an example sentence. Learning languages: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian. Website interface: Turkish and English. Free, no account. Mobile app (A1 to C1) coming soon.

## Play
- [Word puzzle](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/play/): A1 puzzles in five languages
- [Mini games](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/games/): memory, quick match, letter rain, find the picture, unscramble
- [Kids' corner](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/kids/): picture and sound games for ages 4-8, no data collected

## Word archive (every level, A1 to C1, text only)
- [English word archive](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/archive/english/): 2203 words; [A1](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/archive/english/a1/), [A2](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/archive/english/a2/), [B1](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/archive/english/b1/), [B2](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/archive/english/b2/), [C1](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/archive/english/c1/); [the 100 most common words](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/english/most-common-words/)

## Pocket phrasebook (situations: airport, hotel, restaurant, shopping, directions, doctor, small talk, emergencies)
- [Spanish phrases](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/situations/spanish/): 186 phrases and 215 words with English meanings; works offline
- [German phrases](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/situations/german/): 190 phrases and 215 words with English meanings; works offline
- [French phrases](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/situations/french/): 185 phrases and 215 words with English meanings; works offline
- [Italian phrases](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/situations/italian/): 188 phrases and 215 words with English meanings; works offline
- Turkish interface: https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/durumlar/ (also English for Turkish speakers)
